answer: Concurrent Pearl Uniqueness Rounds. At a random instant each epoch, every identity must solve a fresh 60-second live pearl challenge, so one human can clear only one identity per round, and each miss burns a copper stake that doubles with every consecutive miss. A 50-identity farm run by 5 people misses 45 per round: after 6 epochs each has lost 1+2+4+8+16+32=63 copper, 2,835 in total, and the loss keeps rising exponentially. Counter: a vine of rented humans answering in parallel. That works, but it costs one wage per identity per round, forever, so the farm can never pool its costs.
